subject.title: feature request: `chat.history` should support a visible-only filter so `limit` can count conversation messages instead of transcript rows

question: Should `chat.history` gain an additive conversation-view projection, a separate conversation-history method, or remain transcript-oriented with clients responsible for oversampling?
rationale: The need is source-reproducible, but choosing public pagination, total-count, cursor, compaction, and mixed-content semantics changes the long-lived Gateway protocol contract.

options.title: Add conversation view
options.body: Add an optional `view: "conversation"` projection while retaining the current transcript view and pagination semantics as the default.

options.title: Add separate method
options.body: Create a dedicated conversation-history RPC so transcript and presentation pagination contracts remain fully separate.

options.title: Keep client filtering
options.body: Keep `chat.history` transcript-oriented and require clients to request larger pages and discard hidden rows.

recommendation.title: Add conversation view
recommendation.body: Add an optional `view: "conversation"` projection while retaining the current transcript view and pagination semantics as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already subscribed to the issue and are the strongest available routing candidate for the public Gateway contract decision.
